title: World levels of every net.bin map registered in overlay-r3 pak23_ps4.txt (u3fix.exe world-levels, world-levels/world_levels.cpp)
notes: General rule: every world level a net.bin map names (+0x70) gets its PS3 registry block (level-name / level-id / package <w>-ingame) in overlay-r3 pak23_ps4.txt, after the last world-* block; a world whose -ingame12.pak is in no overlay fails the step (its plan.tsv row is missing). The region tree's levels are checked against the registry. Found: world-london-mp (London Underground: the station ldn-train-multi streams in only through rgn-ldn-world-1, so after the train there was no geometry or collision) and world-yemen-mp (Airstrip: take-off-sound / air-multi-sound through rgn-yemen-multi-mid-1). Runs after registry-final, remove-lab and netgame-order-119. Diagnosis, the world-london-mp plan row and the insertion code from contributor PR 16.
